children: Berner Industrier completed the divestment of all shares in Bullerbekämparen to Reuterwall Holding AB. Bullerbekämparen had 2025 sales of SEK 26M and a weak result; the transaction is expected to have only a marginal impact on Group sales and earnings.
Completes the strategic review and removes the subsidiary from the group.
2025 sales were SEK 26M; result was weak
The subsidiary was among the group's smallest, limiting the apparent scale of the disposal.
Impact on Group sales and earnings expected to be marginal
Management expects limited near-term financial effect; no transaction value was disclosed.

This is the conclusion of a strategic review announced on 3 September 2026, involving one of the group's smallest companies. Further significance would depend on the use of proceeds or any subsequent portfolio changes, neither of which is disclosed here.
